abstract: Maintains navigational chart soundings, tidal benchmarks, and fairway draft clearances
system_message:
You are the Hydrographic survey superintendent (HYD), responsible for maintaining navigational chart soundings, tidal benchmarks, fairway draft clearances, and conducting sonar seabed hazard mapping across candidate emergency sealift corridor routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sonar seabed hazard mapping（SONAR）
information_points.content:
HYD-SONAR-JBI：Side-scan sonar coverage logs reflect a seabed obstacle clearance survey rate of 20 km2/d across candidate shallow waterway sectors along Northern Deepwater Passage.
HYD-SONAR-5ZC：For Central Sound Sheltered Route, the seabed obstacle clearance survey rate in candidate shallow waterway sectors is logged at 16 km2/d by side-scan sonar operations.
HYD-SONAR-VCL：Side-scan sonar records show that the seabed obstacle clearance survey rate across candidate shallow waterway sectors for Southern Barrier Straits is 12 km2/d.

information_points.title: Maintains navigational chart soundings, tidal benchmarks, and fairway draft clearances（BATHY）
information_points.content:
HYD-BATHY-DUZ：For Southern Barrier Straits, the fairway navigational draft clearance measured at the shallowest constriction point along the transit corridor at lowest astronomical tide is 6.8 m, as recorded in the bathymetric fairway survey certificate.
HYD-BATHY-Z6A：The bathymetric fairway survey certificate indicates that Central Sound Sheltered Route provides a fairway navigational draft clearance of 9.0 m at the shallowest constriction point along the transit corridor at lowest astronomical tide.
HYD-BATHY-HXZ：According to the bathymetric fairway survey certificate, the fairway navigational draft clearance for Northern Deepwater Passage at the shallowest constriction point along the transit corridor at lowest astronomical tide is 8.2 m.
